observations.publisher: Bahrain Defence Force via ARN News Centre
observations.summary: Bahrain Defence Force reported repelling additional Iranian aerial attacks early November 18. Interior Ministry issued two potential-threat warnings and all-clears; a building evacuation and fire were reported, but the cause of the fire was under investigation. No verified target damage or link between fire and attack. Distinct from November 17 Sheikh Isa incident; precise source release timestamp unavailable.
observations.title: Bahrain reports additional Iranian aerial attacks and defensive interceptions on November 18

observations.publisher: Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen via Arab News
observations.summary: Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki said early November 18 that coalition forces struck 60 Houthi military targets across Sanaa, Amran, Saada and Hodeidah, including claimed underground missile storage and drone workshops. Scale and damage are coalition claims not independently verified; precise initial source release time unavailable.
observations.title: Saudi-led coalition reports strikes on 60 Houthi military sites in Yemen
